## GOOG ($329.33)

### Strategy Selector
IV Rank ~75% favors selling premium. Stock 2.9% below 200MA after 12.2% pullback. RSI 44.3 neutral-low. **Recommendation: CSP — getting paid elevated premium to potentially buy at a discount.**

### Cash-Secured Put — 🟡 MARGINAL (3/4)
- ✅ IV Rank ≥40% (75th pctl — well elevated)
- ❌ Daily RSI ≤40 (RSI 44.3 — close but not oversold)
- ✅ Price near support (2.9% below 200MA at $339.09)
- ✅ Premium yield ≥1.0% ($300: 1.24%, $305: 1.59%)

**Best strike: $305 (Nov 20, 30 DTE)**
- Premium: $4.85 mid (1.59% yield)
- Effective cost basis if assigned: $300.15 (24.7% below 52w high)
- OI: 3,035 — decent liquidity
- Alternate: $310 strike ($6.15, 2.01% yield) slightly more aggressive

### Covered Call — 🟡 MARGINAL (2/4)
- ✅ IV Rank ≥40% | ❌ RSI ≥60 (44.3) | ❌ Weekly RSI overbought (43.5) | ✅ Premium yield ≥0.8%
- Stock is in a pullback — don't cap upside. Wait for RSI>60 recovery bounce.

### LEAPS Monitor — 🟡 MONITORING (3/6)
- Score: 3/6 (weekly RSI stabilizing, near 200MA, liquid LEAPS chain 1.3-3.6% spreads)
- Missing: RSI not oversold (44), IV Rank 75% (overpaying for premium), pullback 12.2% (not 15%)
- Watch for: Drop to $310-$315 with IV compression → potential 🟢

---

## NVDA ($220.20) — Best Setup Today

### Strategy Selector
RSI 38.2 approaching oversold during pullback from highs. IV rank ~53% is moderate but workable. High conviction on AI infrastructure thesis. **Recommendation: CSP at 200MA support.**

### Cash-Secured Put — 🟡 MARGINAL (3/4)
- ✅ IV Rank ≥40% (53rd pctl)
- ✅ Daily RSI ≤40 (RSI 38.2 — in oversold pullback territory)
- ❌ Price near support (8.4% above 200MA at $203 — not near major support)
- ✅ Premium yield ≥1.0% ($200: 1.52%, $195: 1.14%)

**Recommended strike: $200 (Nov 20, 30 DTE)**
- Bid/Ask: $3.00/$3.05 — extremely tight spread
- Premium: ~$3.05 (1.52% yield, 18.3% annualized)
- Effective cost basis if assigned: $196.95 (17.6% below 52w high)
- Open Interest: 58,277 — massive liquidity
- Strike at 200MA ($203) — natural support level
- Would I own NVDA at $197? Yes — dominant AI compute position.

**Conservative: $195** — $2.22 premium (1.14% yield), cost basis $192.78, 28K OI
**Aggressive: $205** — $4.15 premium (1.98% yield), cost basis $200.85, 28K OI

### Covered Call — 🟡 MARGINAL (2/4)
- RSI 38.2 = stock pulling back. Don't sell calls into weakness. Wait for RSI>60 and price near $235-$240.

### LEAPS Monitor — 🔴 NO SETUP (2/6)
- Passes: weekly RSI stable (57.7), liquid options chain (0.7-2.1% spreads, 37K OI on $200 LEAPS)
- Missing: RSI not oversold (38 but not <35), 8.4% from support, IV rank 53%, pullback only 8%
- Need deeper pullback to $200-$205 with IV compression for 🟢.

---

## TSLA ($386.82)

### Strategy Selector
RSI 66.4 approaching overbought at 200MA. IV rank ~60% moderately elevated. **Recommendation: Covered calls — sell into strength, harvest elevated IV.**

### Cash-Secured Put — 🟡 MARGINAL (2/4) → SKIP
- ✅ IV Rank ≥40% (60th pctl)
- ❌ Daily RSI ≤40 (RSI 66.4 — overbought, NOT a pullback)
- ❌ Price near support (at 60d highs, right at 200MA from above)
- ✅ Premium yield ≥1.0% ($350: 1.74%, $360: 2.39%)

**SKIP.** Selling puts into overbought strength = catching falling knife if reversal. Premium looks attractive but setup is wrong. Wait for pullback to $350-$360 with RSI<40.

### Covered Call — 🟡 MARGINAL (3/4)
- ✅ IV Rank ≥40% | ✅ RSI ≥60 (66.4) | ❌ Weekly RSI overbought (51.3 — not confirming) | ✅ Premium yield ≥0.8%

**Recommended strike: $420 (Nov 20, 30 DTE)**
- Premium: $8.10 mid (2.08% yield)
- 8.6% above current price
- If called away at $420: capital gain + premium = ~10.7% total return
- OI: 9,394 — liquid

**Alternative: $410** ($10.95, 2.73% yield, 6% OTM)
**Caution:** Weekly RSI 51.3 suggests uptrend still early — bigger move possible. Consider waiting for weekly confirmation before selling.

### LEAPS Monitor — 🔴 NO SETUP (2/6)
- Passes: near 200MA, liquid options chain (0.8-2.0% spreads)
- Missing: RSI overbought (wrong direction), IV rank 60% (expensive), 0% pullback, weekly not post-decline
- Absolutely wrong time for LEAPS. Need 15%+ pullback with IV compression.
